summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 in which Finward Bancorp announces the declaration of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share, payable June 29, 2026 to holders of record on June 17, 2026. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or similar. The disclosure is an ordinary dividend declaration with standard forward-looking language and references to a prior regulatory memorandum of understanding. As it involves no extraordinary corporate transaction, the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
